title: Baffled Twin-Arch Ruin Path
description: Two complete perpendicular offset portals are connected by a finite supported dogleg route around the west end of a complete breached wall. A single complete column marks a northern side viewing pocket. The breach retains its full lower wall and is not treated as an entrance. One scene, zero independent models, no old geometry alterations; static finite empty volumes only, no continuous navigation, accessibility, archaeology, structural, stability or safety claim. Four unit-scale rigid placements retain every original mesh, hierarchy, full oriented triangle, and opaque solid PBR: two intact thirteen-voussoir stone arches, one complete deep-breached masonry wall, and one whole fluted column. Six connected whole empty route and viewing volumes are checked against all actual old meshes and are entirely supported by one scene-only ground slab. The wall creates a south approach, west bypass and north return before the east-facing exit; neither arch is a variant or new model. The .06m outer base step needs external placement. No props, doors, rubble, vegetation, new standalone model or historical reconstruction.
